summary: Newspaper weather map of Finland from the Finnish Meteorological Institute (Ilmatieteen laitos) with weather symbols, temperatures (−10 to +1 °C) and wind speeds (m/s); used as a prompt for describing the weather around the country.

exercises.title: Describe the weather on the map
exercises.instruction: Say what the weather is like in each part of Finland (sample answers).

items.answer: Aurinko paistaa. On kahdeksan astetta pakkasta.
items.en: The sun is shining. It's minus eight.

items.answer: On puolipilvistä. On kymmenen astetta pakkasta.
items.en: It's partly cloudy. It's minus ten.

items.answer: On pilvistä ja tuulee viisi metriä sekunnissa.
items.en: It's cloudy and the wind is 5 m/s.

items.answer: On puolipilvistä. On yksi aste lämmintä.
items.en: It's partly cloudy. It's plus one.

items.answer: Aurinko paistaa. On kolme astetta pakkasta.
items.en: The sun is shining. It's minus three.
